claims: The 98th Academy Awards will take place on Sunday, March 15, 2026.
The 98th Academy Awards will start at 7 p.m. ET / 4 p.m. PT.
The 98th Academy Awards ceremony is hosted by Conan O'Brien.
The 98th Academy Awards ceremony is at the Dolby Theatre in Los Angeles.
The 98th Academy Awards ceremony will air live on ABC.
The official pre-show for the 98th Academy Awards starts at 6:30 p.m. ET / 3:30 p.m. PT.
The Official Red Carpet Show for the 98th Academy Awards starts at 6:30 p.m. ET / 3:30 p.m. PT on ABC and Hulu.
The E! Red Carpet for the 98th Academy Awards begins at 1 p.m. ET / 10 a.m. PT.
Streaming options for the 98th Academy Awards include Hulu, YouTube TV, FuboTV.
According to this official 98th Oscars page, nominations voting takes place from January 12–16, 2026.
